column3: The RustFS module opens with Service, Version, Configuration, Log, and Error Log tabs.
The Version tab lists RustFS 1.0.0-beta.11-preview.1 with an Install action.
The selected RustFS release is downloading in the Version tab.
The Version tab then marks that RustFS release installed.
The Service tab shows the installed version, data directory, environment, and start control.
Configuration presents RustFS address, console address, security, and KMS fields.
Additional configuration sections show Console, observability, and performance settings.
The Log tab displays the visible RustFS startup log entries.
The local RustFS Console opens at 127.0.0.1:9001 with Key Login and STS Login.
After login, the Console opens the Buckets page, which currently shows no buckets.
The Access Keys view opens its Create Key form.
The Console confirms a new access key and warns that the secret key is shown only once.
The Access Keys table shows the newly available key.
The Console then shows the Users page.
The User Groups page and Bucket Events navigation are visible.
The Lifecycle page is also visible without any buckets.
FlyEnv returns to the running RustFS service while the Console remains open behind it.
